title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone) GGUF, vision-focused
slug_note: OpenBMB's vision model on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B language backbone; Q4_K_M is 21.2 GB. A lead, not a full recipe yet.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M 21.17 GB + vision projector 1.12 GB (mmproj-model-f16.gguf). Other files from 15.5 GB (mix_q3) to 69.4 GB (F16).

engine.config: llama.cpp with the vision projector; OpenBMB's on-device speed numbers use their llama.cpp-omni fork

requirements.notes: Estimate: 21.17 GB Q4_K_M + 1.12 GB projector + KV. Tight on a 24 GB card.

steps.text: Download MiniCPM-V-4_7-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf and mmproj-model-f16.gguf from openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-gguf.
Serve them with llama.cpp's server, passing the projector with --mmproj. The model card gives no literal llama.cpp command, so none is copied here.
Ollama: only a 1B tag (openbmb/minicpm-v4.7:1b) exists as of 2026-10-13; there is no 35B Ollama build yet.

caveats: Built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: the card credits 'Qwen3.6 for providing the language backbone'. Listed here as a vision-focused variant of that family.

OpenBMB's own table: ahead of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 5 of 8 text benchmarks (e.g. IFBench 47.67 vs 35.33) and behind on 3 (MMLU-Pro 83.45 vs 84.11, SuperGPQA 61.23 vs 63.37, BFCL 60.06 vs 60.20). Not independently reproduced.
No literal run command on the card and no speed numbers yet: a lead, not a recipe.
